en.v: Alcohol is sold only to customers aged {age} or older. Minors may not buy alcohol. Valid government photo ID is required at delivery or pickup. If the ID check fails, you are refunded to your Wantiss wallet minus the delivery fee.
I am {age} or older and will show valid government photo ID on delivery or pickup.
If the ID check fails, the alcohol returns to the store and you are refunded to your Wantiss wallet minus the delivery fee.
Create a Wantiss wallet so any refund has somewhere to go. You can withdraw from it later.
Your order is confirmed. {store} is on it.
Your order is on the way. ETA {eta} min.
Your order includes alcohol. Have your valid photo ID ready.
The ID check failed. {amount} was refunded to your Wantiss wallet.
How do I track my order?
Open Orders, then tap Track on an active order. You also get a notification at every step.
Delivery takes about 15 to 55 minutes depending on the store. Your first order ships free; after that each store sets its own fee.
Pay with your Wallet, MonCash, a saved card or cash.
You can cancel before the store finishes preparing your order. Wallet payments are refunded to your wallet.
What if an item is missing?
Open the order, tap Get help, and tell us what happened.
